artifacts.fresh: outputs/upl_gpu_darcy_actual_{Job}_r1 and separate _review; logs same stem .run.json/.check.json/.call.json
artifacts.retained: outputs/upl_gpu_darcy_actual_retained_{Job}_r1_review and logs same retained stem; never copy or alter original solver output
artifacts.pair_gates: figures/upl_gpu_darcy_actual_k0_bridge_c_r1.json, k0_bridge_h_r1.json, k0_half_r1.json and cross_c_r1.json are separately authored/executed offline pair results. per_job_verification: Seal owned call/log even on failure; no overwrite/rerun. Require actual finish steps/end/dt/private complete-rate/no-rewrite/PRE-release, all native frames, then independent typed reader. Check512IDs/33columns/actual dyadic clocks/zero-basedsteps/ledger/energy<=1.1/savedcuDt/h<=.01/savedDdt/h²<=.01/signeddterror<=1e-14/original5e-13ledger/nonemptyJ and schema. Fresh GPU actual live final J/n/theta CSV must byte-match saved final reader CSV. The saved screens are not independent force-stage trace or sufficient stability.
later_pair_thresholds: Original all257sample pressureRMS<=5Pa/materialXYZ displacementmax<=.005mm; new completek0 and positive GPU independent halves also normalizedp/Pstar,v/A,u/Ustar<=1e-4. Same-dt bridges and backend cross use absolute gates only; normalizedcross and all33 field differences are descriptive. No automatic physical/full/public acceptance.
failure_policy: A solver finishing with offline reader/postcheck failure is preserved. Use a newly reviewed analysis label for repair, never relaunch the completed solver or change thresholds. Failed r1 compile, r2 synthetic owner input, r3 wrapper reserved-variable evidence remain protected.
